description: Validate actual short exported video at 2–32 times with decoded RGB tolerances and optional decoded-audio RMS windows. Rejects stills and mismatched samples; records fixture/artifact hashes and explicit declared host provenance. This sampled harness does not prove all frames, Undo/reopen, playback, glyphs or destination compatibility.

audio_samples.description: Optional actual decoded-audio energy checks; analysis downmixes to mono 48kHz and cannot prove multichannel routing.

expected_cep_target.description: Optional reviewed CEP sequence/clip identity and exact tick ranges. Checked before every generated command; UXP refuses this CEP-only guard.

effect.description: Reviewed effect and parameter identity checked before mutation.

match_name.description: Effect match name from host inspection.

end_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive timeline end ticks.

out_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive source Out ticks.

track_index.description: Expected zero-based track index; identity still checked.

project_document_id.description: Exact Premiere project document ID observed during review.

source_item.description: Reviewed source identity for a source-only operation.

expected_project_path.description: Optional absolute saved-project path. Every generated CEP command refuses before its body when the active project differs or is unsaved. UXP commands refuse this CEP-only guard; local-only tools do not inspect Premiere. Omit to keep existing behavior.

fixture_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of generated fixture/input definition.

host.description: Optional caller-declared licensed-host provenance; artifact analysis cannot authenticate these values.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-chosen key (1-128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -) for this intended edit. Pass a fresh key per edit and reuse it only when retrying that same edit, for example after a client-side timeout. A repeat with the same tool, key and arguments is not run again: while the first call is running it fails with IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (poll get_last_operations); after it finished it returns the original outcome marked replayed. A definite failure with nothing applied (receipt outcome not_applied) may be retried with the same key. Reusing a key with different arguments fails with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Scoped to this MCP session (the stdio server process or one HTTP session) and held in memory only (200 keys, 1 hour); it does not survive a restart or reconnect. Read-only invocations are never deduplicated.

path.description: Absolute existing caller-selected video artifact (maximum 1 GiB, expected duration at most 60 seconds).

samples.description: Expected temporal image checks; choose times around transitions and interpolation, with compression-aware tolerances.

mean_rgb.description: Expected mean RGB after 32x32 area scaling of whole frame or explicit region; not an HDR/legal-range assertion.

items.description: Expected red, green or blue mean.

region.description: Optional explicit pixel ROI for spatial motion/effect oracles; must fit decoded video dimensions.

seconds.description: Sample time before exclusive artifact end.

name: verify_temporal_render_artifact

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

idempotency.description: Present when idempotency_key deduplicated this call: replayed is true when the original outcome was returned instead of running again.

receipt.description: Versioned common mutation receipt; success never implies rendered verification.

title: Verify Temporal Render Artifact
